messages:
ashok: heads up, ran a quant sweep on juno9b (int4 PTQ) against our summarization evals. baseline fp16 ROUGE-L 0.423. int4 overall ROUGE-L 0.412 (~-2.6%).
ashok: also saw sporadic OOMs when max_new_tokens >= 256 — looks like a KV arena fragmentation spike on long generations.
tessa: can you share the exact canary config you used?
ashok: sure, used this payload for the canary:
```json
{"model":"juno9b","variant":"int4","batch_size":4,"max_new_tokens":512,"prefetch_kv":true,"kv_eviction_threshold":0.15}
```
eli: thanks. quick grep of the node logs shows repeated small cudaMalloc/free churn around the KV compaction path — likely lots of short-lived allocations causing fragmentation.
maria: do we see the same behavior if we turn prefetch off?
ashok: disabling prefetch removed the OOMs in our smoke runs but increased p50 by ~25ms and p99 by ~120ms. tradeoff between stability and tail latency.
perf-bot: perf-alert: int4 canary run 1749012345 -> p99 latency +10% vs baseline; QoS threshold breached.
infra-bot: alert: CUDA OOM on gpu-3 at 2024-08-21T14:32:12Z during canary (trace id 0a7f9c).
tessa: proposed mitigations: 1) temporarily lower juno9b-int4 default max_new_tokens to 128, 2) bump kv_eviction_threshold to 0.25 so eviction is more aggressive, 3) enable batch pacing (cwnd=3) to reduce allocation bursts.
eli: and add a runtime fallback: if OOM or mem_frag_ratio > 0.6, route request to juno9b-fp16 variant automatically. prevents user-facing failures.
ashok: sounds good. I'll open a rollout PR: 10% canary for 2h with those flags, capture eval harness diffs and traces.
maria: +1 from me, but add a quality gate: int4 must be within 1.5% ROUGE-L of fp16 baseline on the summarization suite for the canary to proceed.
ashok: noted. I'll attach the eval artifacts and the perf traces to the PR. if the quality gate fails we'll auto-rollback to fp16 for canary.
ashok: next steps: create PR, kick the 10% canary, and follow-up in this thread with links to artifacts. anyone else want to review the rollout config?
tessa: I'll take a look after lunch, thanks for the writeup. :thumbsup:
eli: logging a short playbook entry for this (juno9b-int4 frag workaround) so oncall can triage faster next time.
maria: FYI we should add a note to the onboarding checklist: run long-gen traces (>=512 tokens) in addition to short summarization tests.
ashok: agreed. will add to PR checklist.
